text.name: Rune of Charge
text.description:
{Rune of Charge}

Allow hero to use {Rune of Charge}.
Learning {Runes} skill can enhance the effect.
Once the number of uses is exhausted, the runestone will disappear.
text.event: You find a runestone during your travels and put it in your bag.
